createDialog.title: Create user
createDialog.description: New accounts start with the "user" role — promote them below if needed. They're created with the default seed password ("{{seedPassword}}") until a password reset flow exists.

editDialog.title: Edit user
editDialog.description: Role changes and deletion are handled from the table.

deleteDialog.title: Delete user?
deleteDialog.descriptionTemplate: This will permanently delete {{username}}. This cannot be undone.

roleChangeDialog.title: Change role?
roleChangeDialog.descriptionTemplate: Set {{username}}'s role to "{{role}}"? This changes what they can access.
